import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_17/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_17/training_1.csv"

df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history: JOIN on ["school_name"]
# Join df_source0 and df_source1 on 'school_name' column
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Reorder and select columns to match the target schema exactly:
# Target Schema: 
# ['School ID': int, 'school_name': str, 'type': str, 'size': int, 'budget': int,
#  'Student ID': int, 'student_name': str, 'gender': str, 'grade': str,
#  'reading_score': int, 'math_score': int]

# Ensure correct dtypes and column order
df_result = df_joined[
    [
        "School ID",
        "school_name",
        "type",
        "size",
        "budget",
        "Student ID",
        "student_name",
        "gender",
        "grade",
        "reading_score",
        "math_score",
    ]
].copy()

# Convert columns to target types explicitly
df_result["School ID"] = df_result["School ID"].astype(int)
df_result["school_name"] = df_result["school_name"].astype(str)
df_result["type"] = df_result["type"].astype(str)
df_result["size"] = df_result["size"].astype(int)
df_result["budget"] = df_result["budget"].astype(int)
df_result["Student ID"] = df_result["Student ID"].astype(int)
df_result["student_name"] = df_result["student_name"].astype(str)
df_result["gender"] = df_result["gender"].astype(str)
df_result["grade"] = df_result["grade"].astype(str)
df_result["reading_score"] = df_result["reading_score"].astype(int)
df_result["math_score"] = df_result["math_score"].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_17/target_multisource.csv"
df_result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
